Are you sure you want to rename this network?

The network will be renamed for all users of this computer. This might make it difficult for other users to find and connect to this network in the future.
20063.title: Manage Wireless Networks

controls: Choose the type of profile to assign to new wireless networks

By default, connections to wireless networks from your computer can be accessed by anyone with a user account on the computer (all-user). If you change this setting, users can create connections that can only be accessed and modified by them (per-user).
Using per-user profiles can cause a loss of network connectivity when logging off or switching between users
